name: Get Program by Name
summary: Finds a program's ID from its exact name — handy when you only know what the program is called.
whenToUse: When you know the program name (as shown in the Marketo UI) but not its ID.

query.name: name
query.label: Program name
query.hint: The exact program name as it appears in Marketo (case-sensitive).

notes: The name must match exactly — if you get nothing back, list all programs and copy the name from there.
